title: Kernel and surjectivity of restriction of a single injective module
statement: Let R be a commutative Noetherian local ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], W an open of Spec R whose points are exactly those different from the closed point [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], and M an injective R-module. The kernel of the concrete map tilde.toOpen M W is Ideal.primaryComponent M m, the submodule of elements killed by some power of m [def-sbc-ideal-power-torsion-functor], where m is the maximal ideal. The same map is surjective.

source.place: Tag 09T2, Lemma 36.8.1; Tag 0A6T, proof of Lemma 51.2.1 (principal open covering and localization)

proof.text: Use the fully proved arbitrary-module kernel computation.

Apply injective_tilde_isFlasque to M. ModuleCat.epi_iff_surjective makes the restriction from top to W surjective. Lift a section on W to top, and then to M through tilde.isoTop. The identity tilde.toOpen_res identifies its restriction with tilde.toOpen M W.

lean.statement:
theorem injective_punctured_restriction_exact
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsLocalRing R]
    (W : (Spec (.of R)).Opens)
    (hW : ∀ x : Spec (.of R), x ∈ W ↔ x ≠ IsLocalRing.closedPoint R)
    (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) [Injective M] :
    (tilde.toOpen M W).hom.ker = Ideal.primaryComponent M (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) ∧
      Function.Surjective (tilde.toOpen M W)
